    <footnotes>
        <footnote id="F1">Each performance stock unit (&quot;PSU&quot;) represents a contingent right to receive 1 share of the Issuer's Common Stock upon settlement for no consideration.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F2">Shares earned upon the vesting of a percentage of the PSUs granted to the Reporting Person on November 1, 2026. Each PSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of Issuer common stock upon the Issuer's achievement of certain share price metrics (&quot;Performance Metrics&quot;). Once an applicable Performance Metric has been met, the PSUs subject to such Performance Metric (an &quot;Achieved PSU&quot;) shall vest as follows: 50% of the Achieved PSUs for each satisfied tranche shall vest on the one-year anniversary of the Certification Date of the achievement of the applicable Performance Metric, and the remaining 50% of the Achieved PSUs shall vest on the two-year anniversary of the applicable Certification Date.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F3">(cont'd from Footnote 2) Notwithstanding the foregoing, all Achieved PSUs that have not previously vested pursuant to the vesting schedule will vest on December 15, 2030 (or, if a Share Price Target is achieved on December 15, 2030, vesting will occur on its Certification Date), subject to the Reporting Person's service to the Issue on each vesting date.</footnote>
